component.name: RustView
component.summary: Fast image and video browser with folders, tags and ratings

description.p: RustView is a media browser for large libraries of images and videos. It keeps its own library, scrolls through hundreds of thousands of thumbnails without stutter and never touches the drive unless you start a refresh.

ul.li: Thumbnail grid and table view with a folder tree, favorites, hierarchical tags and ratings
Hover previews for videos and animated pictures, thumbnail badges, type-ahead find
Multiview: up to four images or videos side by side, in a fullscreen or in a tab, with image zoom
Embedded mpv player and FFmpeg decoding for dozens of image and video formats
Copy, move, rename and delete with conflict handling, drag and drop to other applications
